notes.title: Legends of Old Patch 07.14.2025
notes.content:
[i]The following is a large patch which significantly overhauls certain portions of the game. If you've been waiting to create an alt, now's a good time to do so![/i]

[list]
[*] - The way named loot is obtained has been significantly overhauled. Previously, each ‘race’ of monster had its own shared loot pool. This was problematic for many reasons, and limited our ability to place named monsters around. Now, every named mob in the game has its own unique loot table.

[*] - Added many new named monsters to be found, each with their own unique loot table.

[*] - Added over 150 items to the game, including a ton of ROG base types. These new base types include weapons spanning the entirety of the leveling process, and will help players make incremental upgrades as they progress. Additionally, many new non-weapon base types have implicit modifiers such as +health or +mana to further assist in the early game.

[*] - Did a complete rebalance of all weapons in the game. This change normalizes the amount of power granted by weapons. Early game weapons should be more powerful, and late game weapons have been reduced. Generally speaking, weapons have a damage value range from 4 on the low end to 15 on the high end. Additionally, the amount of delay a weapon type has is now much more consistent across the board.

[*] - Multiplicative scaling mods (+x% melee damage, for example) have been reduced significantly. The goal for the system is to have to trade off several slots for the bonuses, and for it not to simply be "free". We'll continue to monitor and adjust how impactful this system is.

[*] - Added very rare "+ to Elemental Pet Level" mods on items. This helps the Elementalist have additional scaling options in the late game. If this proves a popular and desirable avenue, will see about expanding its availability and adjusting base stats of pets to compensate.

[*] - Rebalanced the starting stats of all classes to allow for a sturdier early game. This should help new characters get their footing before they start to find gear.

[*] - Adjusted the amount of HP gained from stamina at higher levels. Certain item combinations were giving too much HP, to the point of characters being immortal.

[*] - Adjusted the exp curve throughout the game. This should help players obtain a bit more gear appropriate to their level before leveling up.

[*] - Rebalanced the difficulty of several higher end mobs in the game. Additionally, there were many outliers throughout that were too powerful for their area. These monsters have been brought in line.
[*] 
[*] - Endurance costs for all Melee Styles have been cut in half. Endurance Regeneration has also been cut in half. This allows for more actions to be performed on a full endurance bar, but it takes longer to recover after depleting it. Endurance should be less of a consideration now in most cases where players are not hasted.

[*] - The windows for performing a reactionary parry, evade, or block style have been widened by 10%.

[*] - Icebolt's snare effect has been increased from 6 seconds to 12 seconds.

[*] - Rogue Bombs have had their individual cooldowns reduced from 30s per use to 20s per use.

[*] - Fixed a bug where Rogue offhanded attacks would fail to fire if you began combat using a style - this could also lead to a desynced state where you could never do offhand damage if the bug occurred.

[*] - Fixed a bug where Chance to Avoid Endurance cost was using the wrong values.

[*] - Deployed a fix that could allow characters of another class to obtain reaver spells when playing online. Please let us know if this issue happens again, as it is incredibly rare and hard to reproduce.
[/list]

notes.title: Legends of Old patch 07.02.2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - Tremor has gone on a rampage and may have opened up new areas down in the caves he resides in...

[*] - Added Floating Text Widgets for Parry, Block, and Evade, to better signal when the player has performed these actions. This should help players perform reactionary styles more consistently.

[*] - Added "Reduced Endurance Cost" and "Chance to Avoid Endurance Cost" mods to the item drop pool.

[*] - Added support for "Hexer" mobs, which can debuff or snare the player. 

[*] - Added many more Named mobs to fight.

[*] - Added many new Named Items to be found.

[*] - Fixed a bug where Multiplicative Scaling from items was not working properly (+20% base melee damage, for example, wasn't actually scaling damage multiplicatively as it should do)

[*] - Fixed a bug where Voltaxic Bomb was applying Fire Bomb's Fire Damage Over Time effect

[*] - Fixed an issue where ROG items were at a lower power level than intended. Players should notice a significant improvement to mods that roll on ROG items, especially at higher levels.


[/list]

notes.title: Legends of Old Patch Notes 06.28.2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - Windlace (Haste) has been rebalanced. Its haste value has been reduced, as it previously  left little room for Agility to meaningfully impact attack speed. To compensate, Agility now has a significantly stronger effect on attack speed.
[*] The fastest attack speeds from before are still achievable when pairing high agility + Windlace, but solo players will no longer be heavily penalized for lacking an Elementalist to cast Windlace on them. 

[*] - Rogues have had their Melee Damage increased significantly. Additionally, Fire Bomb and Voltaxic Bomb have had their damage increased.

[*] - Added a new "Floating Text Widget" that lets you know when you crit. 

[*] - Added new "+Melee Critical Strike Chance" modifiers that can be found on items. 

[*] - Added new "+Chance to avoid Stuns" modifier that can be found on items. 

[*] - Fixed item generation issues that crashed the game when very high level players killed powerful monsters

[*] - Did a full audit of every named monster in the game; they should all now have loot. 

[*] - Added many new Named Items to be found, with a focus on slots that were previously too rare or didn't exist in the Named Item drop pool. These new items have been added throughout the entire game, so its worth checking out all the named monsters again.

[*] - Rebalanced Rogue Melee Style endurance costs so they can perform more abilities in solo play

[*] - Added a new Rogue Melee Style, "Breaking Point", which is described as: "After performing Eviscerate, stun the target."

[*] - Added new Reaver Curse spell, "Urtak's Verdict", which is described as: "Curses the target. Tracks damage dealt. When it exceeds a threshold, the curse triggers and deals heavy poison damage".
[/list]

notes.title: Legends of Old Patchnotes 06.27.2025
notes.content:
Over the past week, we’ve shared several patch notes in our Discord server. However, we understand that not everyone is active there and have heard the community’s feedback. Moving forward, all patch notes will be posted both on Discord and on Steam to ensure everyone stays informed. Thank you for your continued support!


[list]
[*] The crafting bench has been improved in functionality. Previously, it would return a random base type regardless of  what you were disenchanting. Now, the items you input have an affect on the outcome. Inputting a majority of weapons will return a weapon, with similar functionality for armor or "accessories". We intend to improve this system further in the future where two swords yields a sword, two bracers yields a bracer, and so on.

[*] Updated Slam description to "After a successful block, retaliate with a stunning blow."

[*] Updated Luminael's Vengeance description to "From the side, attack the target for elevated damage. Follow up with Luminael's Blessing.".

[*] Updated Luminael's Blessing description to "After Luminael's Vengeance, provide a heal to you and allies."

[*] Fixed a bug where Luminael's Vengeance was providing a bonus to Evasion.

[*] Fixed a bug where Melee Styles were gaining their damage bonus values even on failed styles
 
[*] Added new One Hand Crush options to the drop pool, to help with Paladin itemization.
 
[*] Added new One Hand Axe options to the drop pool, to help with Paladin itemization.

[*] Fixed a bug where Longswords were incredibly rare drops.

[*] Adjusted Party Difficulty Modifier for 3 and 4 player parties (Mobs will have less HP than they did before the patch)

[*] Fixed some named mobs loot tables.

[*] Fixed a bug where Luminael's Blessing wasn't healing properly.

[*] Fixed a bug where Mudmen could be stunned while charging and their AI would break (This doesn't affect Iceblock).

[*] Fixed a few areas players could get stuck.

[*] Fixed a few Out-of-bounds issues.

[*] Fixed an issue with "LightTank" mobs offhand damage sometimes dealing 0 damage.

[*] Fixed an issue with Chains of Eltair sometimes dealing 0 damage.

[*] Fixed an issue with Ice Sphere where non-host elementalists could crash the game by targetting a player with it.

[*] Fixed an issue where Shields were not dropping.

[*] Fixed a bug where Festulence's Crypt could not be accessed in rare cases.

[*] Fixed a bug where The Moldmaster was not dropping items.

[*] When creating a new character, the "Help Window" (renamed the Survival Guide) will be shown to the player. Some of the text has been rewritten to be more clear, and hopefully it will help new players understand the games mechanics more quickly.
[*] Fixed various misplaced objects.

[*] Fixed a memory issue; the game should be much more performant now with long sessions

[*] Added a new Melee Style to the Reaver called Gore Harvest, which is described as: "Swing your weapon to hit all enemies around you. Each enemy hit heals you for an amount."

[*] Added 50 new named items to be found

[*] Fixed a few mobs loot tables

[*] Made some named mobs a bit more difficult numerically

[*] Many named spellcasters now have a wider pool of spells available to them and will find new ways to defend their loot

[*] Fixed a crash with Corpseweaver Ghraaz

[*] Fixed an issue where Navmesh wasn't generating in a few specific areas

[*] The physical damage defense formula has changed. Previously, Absorption did not provide the value displayed due to a diminishing returns curve. The curve was too aggressive, and as such it was not as powerful as intended. Now, Absorption provides the displayed % reduction up to 30%, at which point diminishing returns are applied. Additionally, Negation was far too powerful of a stat, outweighing other options. Negation now has sharper diminishing returns after the first few points.

[*] Robes can only be equipped by cloth casters (Elementalists) now. Desirable mods commonly found on robes have been moved to other item slots. This relieves a lot of pressure on the torso slot and makes other slots have more competitive options.

[*] Armortypes have had their base defensive stats adjusted based on feedback / analysis of how people are playing. Leather armor now provides Evasion and Negation, Chainmail provides Evasion, Negation, and Absorption, and Plate provides Negation and Absorption. Do note that this does not apply to previously obtained gear and will only apply to gear generated after the patch. (The goal for defenses in the game is not that any one defensive layer is overpowered, and that the combination of layers, together, makes for a very powerful character. Being able to Parry, Evade, or Block an attack before it ever comes in, and then reduce damage that actually comes in in a multitude of ways, and then recover from that incoming damage in interesting ways, makes for more meaningful gearing decisions.)

[*] Daggers have had their base damage values increased slightly, and we intend to add more dense itemization options for the rogues weapon slots going forward.

[*] Fixed a few issues with mob patrol routes that were leading to insane trains in some zones.
 
[*] Fixed an issue where Sigil of Bulwarking was not being consumed properly

[*] Fixed a bug where  Gore Harvest was not breaking CC with its AoE cleave effect

[*] Fixed a bug where rings/bracers could be put into your mainhand weapon slot

[*] Fixed a crash with Gore Harvest.

[*] Fixed a crash with very high level players crashing due to incorrect item generation.
[/list]
